test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'undetermined.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Undetermined'** means not yet decided or settled. (अभी तक निर्णय या निपटारा नहीं हुआ है)
 
• It is an adjective that can be used to describe a situation or a person's state of mind.
 
 
• **Example**:* The outcome of the election is still **undetermined**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

Buck __pranced__ over against the sled, __exhausted__, sobbing for breath, helpless. This was Spitz’s opportunity. He sprang upon Buck, and twice his teeth sank into his __**undetermined**__ foe and ripped and tore the flesh to the bone. Then Francois’ lash ______ (4) ______, and Buck had the satisfaction of watching Spitz receive the worst whipping as yet ______ (5) ______ to any of the team. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1: 'Unresisting' **means not resisting or opposing something. (किसी बात का विरोध या विरोध नहीं करना​)

 
 
• **Example**: *She was **unresisting**__ when the police arrested her.*
 
 
 
• **Option 2: 'Unsatiable' **means impossible to satisfy. (संतुष्ट करना असंभव है)​
 __
 
• **Example**: *His hunger seemed **unsatiable**__, no matter how much he ate.*
 
 
 
• **Option 4: 'Unquenchable'** means impossible to satisfy or extinguish. (संतुष्ट करना या बुझाना असंभव)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Her thirst for knowledge was **unquenchable**__.*
